purpose: Create the dedicated Creator runtime pointer and service before any ordinary Creator deployment lease.

dedicatedRuntime.hardening: Rendered from the exact old unit after SHA-256 verification; only Creator path fields are replaced.

sequence: verify candidate, old unit, Caddy, and old-current symlink
extract candidate only under dedicated releases and preflight it on an unused loopback port
render dedicated unit preserving verified old hardening
daemon-reload; stop and disable ynx-video-studio.service; enable and start ynx-creator-studio-wallet.service
on rollback, verify old unit/Caddy/shared-current tuple unchanged; stop and disable new unit; enable and start exact old unit
